mathematics.logical_review: The new graded Ore manuscript received a separate full mathematical reading and a separate reconstruction of its core exhaustion proof. Existing general Z-algebra claims were preserved and were not reaudited in this update. These are AI-assisted readings, not formalization or external peer review.

graded_ore_review.scope: Connected locally finite left/right noetherian graded C-algebras, AS dimension 4, minimal degrees (1,1,2,3), and prescribed Hilbert series; graded isomorphisms.
checked: plane embedding in a division ring
dual-resolution coefficient lemma and invariance under lifts
cubic projection ranks and first automorphism invertibility
Hilbert-series proof of PBW and final Ore structure
reverse construction and graded Ext from the cited ungraded theorem
necessity and sufficiency of all triangular graded isomorphisms
word-quadratic specialization and linear isomorphism-existence test
graded_ore_review.primary_sources: LPWZ Lemmas 1.1 and 1.3; LWW Theorem 3.3, Lemma 1.3, sections 1.2 and 1.3, and the precise short-exact-sequence statement of Remark 2.2; Sierra Theorem 1.2.
graded_ore_review.limitations: No formal proof assistant, external peer review, novelty determination, or claim that this solves the full indexed classification.

coverage: diagonal twist action rank and full invariant lattice

skew_ore.engine: Python 3 with SymPy 1.14.0, exact polynomial arithmetic
skew_ore.limitations: Checks polynomial identities only; AS-regularity uses a separate Ore-extension theorem and PBW proof.

project_structure.scope: files, labels/citations/environments, claim and resume links only

typesetting.engine: LuaHBTeX 1.24.0 (TeX Live 2026), LuaLaTeX with LuaTeX-ja and HaranoAji
typesetting.visual_review_scope: All 40 pages rendered with pdftoppm at 110 dpi and inspected as 2x2 page sheets. A separate agent inspected all 25 pages of the main manuscript, plan, notes and diagonal Ore paper; the primary agent inspected all 15 pages of the final graded Ore manuscript.
typesetting.layout_and_reference_checks: No overfull/underfull box, missing-character, unresolved reference/citation, or duplicate PDF destination diagnostic in the final logs. No clipping, overlap, missing glyph or broken table observed in the rendered pages.
typesetting.nonfatal_diagnostics: Japanese-font scaling/feature messages and unavailable italic Japanese font shapes retain the upright form; math font substitutions up to 0.5pt; luatexja array-patch diagnostic. No resulting visual defect observed.

persistence.push_mode: fast-forward update of main through the connected GitHub app; force=false
persistence.remote_verification_method: Compare local HEAD with git ls-remote origin refs/heads/main after pushing.
